responses.value: Lemon reached only 60% of its first-month target and has fallen 30% a month since, likely because shoppers who try it don't like it enough to rebuy. I'd compare repeat-purchase rates for lemon with the brand's other flavors.
Drop: where lemon stayed in stock, repeat buying matched other flavors. The fall comes from stock-outs in 40% of stores.
Weekly lemon sales in stores that never ran out. If they fell 30% a month too, I'd drop it.
